name: Community — Krea 2
author: Krea AI
description: Six Krea 2 single-pass DiT mixes — Moody Mix, RedCraft Red Mix, Realia, Fascium, BF95 Dark Realism and Dark Beast (fp8). Uncensored/photoreal 8-10 step distilled checkpoints at CFG 1, rendering at native ~2 MP (1408x1408 and equivalents) with an Upscale slider (1.1-2x adds a 4-step detail-refine pass; 1x is a clean single pass), all sharing one Qwen3VL 4B encoder and Qwen-Image VAE, so each extra mix costs only its ~12-14 GB checkpoint. Three of the six (RedCraft, Fascium, Dark Beast) are NSFW-capable mixes. The trained finetunes (Muse, FinalCut, Binyuan) moved to the separate Krea 2 Finetunes pack in 1.6.0. Since 1.7.0: two free GGUF builds of Dark Beast (Q8 matches the FP8 original, Q4 fits 8 GB cards), because the FP8 file is now paid on Civitai. Since 1.8.0: two cards from VXP's experimental Krea 2 beta series (INT8, about 14 s a picture at 1 MP): Beta 4 for anime and illustration, Beta 3 for the same look on photographs. Both put a dark, backlit, high-contrast grade on everything, which none of the other cards here give.

presets.name: Moody Krea 2 Mix V1.0
presets.description: Uncensored Krea 2 diffusion-transformer mix tuned for moody, photoreal output. Best skin texture and natural anatomy of the Krea presets. 8-step distilled at CFG 1. Warm, freckled, natural skin; the reference look of the pack. Renders at native ~2 MP; the Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail-refine pass, verified clean at 1.5x.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. euler/simple, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Uncensored mix. Renders at ~2 MP natively (Krea 2 supports 1K-2K); 2048x2048 also works on 12 GB but takes ~3x longer. Upscale >1 adds a lanczos resize plus a 4-step denoise-0.1 refine pass, as in the official Krea 2 Turbo preset; at Upscale 1 the refine is bypassed by a core ComfyMathExpression + ComfySwitchNode gate, because a same-size refine pass blotches skin on these mixes (tested 4 sampler/denoise variants, all bad; 1.5x is clean). Measured 2026-09-01: 1408x1408 in ~25 s on a 4070 Ti (~20 s at 1 MP); Upscale 1.5 to 2112x2112 adds ~10 s. 2048x2048 direct: ~70 s. All six presets were verified at Upscale 1 and 1.5 with the gate in place.

presets.name: Dark Beast Krea 2 (FP8)

presets.name: Dark Beast Krea 2 (GGUF Q8)
presets.tagline: Aggressive uncensored Krea 2, the free Q8 build
presets.description: The same Dark Beast Krea 2 "Aggressive Edition" as the FP8 card, in molbal's free GGUF conversion (Q8). Use this one if you cannot download the FP8 file, which is now paid on Civitai. In our side-by-side it gave the same picture as the FP8 original for the same seed: uncensored, bold, high-contrast, 8 steps at CFG 1. About 40 seconds for a 1408 px picture on a 12 GB card. It is a 14.6 GB download; if disk space or VRAM matters more than an exact match, use the Q4 card. Renders at native ~2 MP with the same Upscale slider.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT as GGUF (diffusion_models) through UnetLoaderGGUFDynamicVRAM + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE, shared with the other Krea 2 cards. Q8_0 GGUF, 14,563,660,832 B, sha256 0C832D89..., Civitai model 2749127 (molbal) version 3092542 file 2972074: a conversion of AiMetatron's version 3078453, the file the FP8 card ships. Tested 2026-10-04 in plain ComfyUI 0.37.2 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB with molbal/ComfyUI-GGUF 48de657, 2 prompts x 2 seeds at 1408x1408 against the FP8 file: same composition and subject on 4 of 4 (24-31 dB), 47-78 s against 29-33 s. Verified in the SimpliGen app 2026-10-06 (engine 0.38.0, 4070 Ti 12 GB): 3 prompts per card at ~2 MP, 6 of 6 clean, 39-40 s each (4 s/step); the Q8 and Q4 portraits are byte-identical to the plain-ComfyUI renders of the same seed. Uses the fork's UnetLoaderGGUFDynamicVRAM with reclaimVramBeforeSampling; its legacy UnetLoaderGGUF ran 60-110 s/step here. The standard city96 loader cannot read this file ("Unexpected architecture type in GGUF file: 'krea2'"), so the card needs the molbal fork. Same graph as the FP8 card apart from the loader: euler/simple, 8 steps, CFG 1, negative zeroed, gated 4-step refine above Upscale 1.

presets.name: VXP Krea 2 Beta 4 (Anime)
presets.description: VXP's Krea 2 Beta 4, the anime branch of an experimental beta series (INT8). It puts one look on everything: strong backlight, rim-lit hair, deep shadows and a dark, high-contrast grade. In our side-by-side none of the other Krea 2 cards gave that picture. Anime and semi-real illustration are its home ground; it also turns photo prompts into illustration, so use Beta 3 or a realism card for photographs. Uncensored, but on clothed prompts it kept the clothes on in our test. 8 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models): Civitai model 2938537, version 3375540 'Beta 4 (Anime) INT8', file 3263832, 13,320,458,040 B, SHA256 d5eba08564bd3891ad7143463e9c3c8096dea6667b458ac7b46720aeb47f0a65; + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE, shared with the other Krea 2 cards (the files on the model page are byte-identical to them). euler/simple, 8 steps, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Tested 2026-10-08 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine 0.38.0, direct submission): 6 prompts x 3 seeds at 1024x1536 against base Krea 2 Turbo, Equinox, Moody, BF95 Dark Realism and Dark Beast, all at 8 steps / CFG 1. Median 14 s per picture. The author publishes no settings; a probe showed 4, 8 and 12 steps at CFG 1 clean and 20 steps at CFG 3.5 as heavy noise, so there is no CFG slider. LICENCE (Civitai): credit not required, no derivatives/merges, commercial use limited to generation services. Verified in the app 2026-10-08 (SimpliGen 1.71.0, engine 0.38.0): 3 seeds at 1216x1632 (3:4), all rendered in 24-26 s, queued checkpoint, seed, steps and sampler read back from the engine. Upscale above 1 and LoRAs not tested on this card.

presets.name: VXP Krea 2 Beta 3 (Hybrid)
presets.tagline: The same dark, backlit look on photos and illustration
presets.description: VXP's Krea 2 Beta 3, the hybrid branch of an experimental beta series (INT8): anime, semi-real and realistic from one checkpoint. It shares Beta 4's dark, backlit, high-contrast look, and on anime and semi-real prompts the two are close. The difference is photographs: Beta 3 keeps them photographic (moody window light, real skin texture) where Beta 4 turns them into illustration. Uncensored. A separate branch, not an older Beta 4. 8 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple.
